summary: Wife of Carmine Gabriele Fiorillo and mother of Domenico and Francesco; John's 6th-great-grandmother.
bio: Giacinta, also written Cintia, was the wife of Carmine Gabriele Fiorillo, who died in 1797, and the mother of Domenico Gabriele Fiorillo (about 1775 to 1849) and Francesco Gabriele Fiorillo (about 1789 to 1853). Her maiden name is given differently from record to record, variously as Feraco, Iera or Marrello. She was John's 6th-great-grandmother.
